units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:3">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="A02906"><he>אקורקרתא</he></cite>, &c., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3) <he>דהויא כי וכ׳</he> a frog as big as Fort Hag. (others read <he>בי</he>, a frog which was in Fort H.).
<cite ref="Nedarim 41a:9">Ned. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>עקרבא דיתיבא על א׳ ועברה נהרא</he> (corr. ed. acc.) a scorpion sitting on a frog and crossing the river.
